description: This file defines the 'HeaderFooter' class within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet namespace. It manages header and footer formatting, including text content, images, and formatting codes used for Excel worksheet headers and footers.

classes.name: HeaderFooter
classes.description: Manages header and footer content, formatting, images, and settings for Excel worksheet headers and footers.

methods.name: getOddHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the odd page header.

methods.name: setOddHeader
methods.description: Sets the content of the odd page header.

methods.name: getOddFooter

methods.name: setOddFooter
